howto.title: How to read this page
howto.rule: Reading a guide builds understanding; it is not a certification. Prove each point with your organisation's own records.

intro.standard: Each page explains one clause in plain words. Read it in this order, then look for the same thing in your own organisation.
intro.practice: Each page explains one practice and how its evidence matures. Read it in this order to find where you stand and what to do next.
intro.method: Each page explains one step of a method. Read it in this order, then try it on a real case in the toolkit.

req.d: the intent of the clause in plain words. Ask: what result must exist, and who decides?

ex.d: the requirement applied in a real setting, so you can recognise it at work.

how.d: the steps to put it in place, in the order you would do them.

ev.d: the records an auditor expects. If you cannot show it, it is not yet in place.

checks.d: rehearse your answers with facts and records, not intentions.

links.d: follow the links: no clause works alone.

req.d: the statement the practice is scored against, with its reference in the source.

ladder.d: three rungs from starting to managed. Your rung is the highest one you can prove today.

how.d: the moves that lift the practice one rung — choose one, do not start them all.

owner.d: who should own the improvement and how you will know it worked.

links.d: fix what a practice depends on first; open the same practice in the other guides.

tool.d: score the practice in the toolkit with your evidence and get the improvement roadmap.

req.d: the purpose of the step and its expected output.

ev.d: what shows the step was done properly.

gaps.d: the mistakes that make the method fail — check your own work against them.

tool.d: complete a real record in the toolkit.

pmi.title: Project, programme, portfolio and PMO learning
pmi.lede: Start from what you can already show, follow a route that skips what you have demonstrated, read every practice of the ISO 21500, P3O, P3M3 and PMO Excellence guides, and plan your PMI certification with facts checked on PMI's own pages.

PMP®, CAPM®, PMI-ACP®, PMI-RMP®, PgMP®, PfMP®, PMI-PBA® and PMBOK® are marks of PMI; P3O® and P3M3® are marks of PeopleCert.

q9.title: Quality management, engineering and excellence
q9.lede: From QA and QC to SPC, auditing, Lean Six Sigma and quality leadership: start from what you can already show, follow a route that skips what you have demonstrated, and plan your ASQ certification with facts checked on ASQ's own pages.

q9.honesty: CIA is not an ASQ partner, its courses are not ASQ-approved and award no recertification units (RUs). The CMQ/OE course carries an exam-preparation label only. CMQ/OE, CQA, CQE, CSSGB, CSSBB, CQIA, CCQM, CQT and CQI are ASQ certification names, used only to identify them.
q9.explorerLede: Nine ASQ certifications: who each is for, what ASQ requires, how the exam is built, and which CIA route and courses help you prepare.

center.title: Prepare for CMQ/OE with your own evidence
center.lede: Diagnose yourself against the seven major Body of Knowledge areas, see your weak areas, get study hours by weight and weakness, and follow a 12-week plan mapped to CIA courses.
center.diagBody: Fourteen original items, two per area. Choose “I don't know” rather than guessing.
center.noAttempt: No attempt yet. Your results will appear here after the diagnostic.
center.readinessNote: Your area results weighted by each area's share of exam questions. A study signal only — not a prediction of an exam result.
center.readinessNone: Available once every area has a result.
center.areasNote: Areas below 60% are weak; 70% and above are demonstrated. Each card links to the CIA courses that teach the area.
center.noWeak: No weak area in your latest attempt.
center.planTitle: 4 · Study hours by weight and weakness
center.planNote: Weak areas get 1.5×, close areas 1.2× their share of questions; one sixth is kept for timed practice.
center.practiceBody: Original CIA items — never ASQ exam questions. Use the course finals as timed mixed practice.
center.progressTitle: Your progress on the CMQ/OE route
